questions.text: There are three 3's and three 4's on this wheel. If you spin it twice, what percent chance (DO NOT include the % symbol) do you have of getting a total of 7?
questions.why: There are four possible outcomes: two 3's, two 4's, 3 and 4, or 4 and 3. Two of those add up to 7, which means you have a 50% chance of getting 7.
